question: According to the census of India 2011, what was the literacy rate of Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.8009**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the literacy rate of Tamil Nadu was **80.09%**.
 
• The literacy rate represents the percentage of people who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Tamil Nadu had a higher literacy rate compared to the national average of **74.04%** in 2011.
 
• Among the southern states of India, Tamil Nadu was one of the states with significant educational achievements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate Definition**

 
 
• Literacy rate is defined as the percentage of people aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
 
 
• **Census of India**
 
 
• The Census of India is a decennial exercise conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country.
 
 
 
• **Educational Initiatives in Tamil Nadu**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu government has launched several schemes to improve literacy, including the Midday Meal Scheme and free education for girls up to postgraduate level.
 
 
 
• **National Literacy Mission**
 
 
• The National Literacy Mission aims to make 80 million adults literate, focusing on women and disadvantaged groups.
 
• It is a government initiative aimed at achieving total literacy in the country.
